title: Synaxis Library activation bundle v2
description: Portable, context-only activation data returned by library_skill_activation when a host requests contractVersion synaxis.library.activation.v2. It is the v1 shape plus, per selected skill, a bundle manifest (file paths, media types, sizes, and SHA-256 digests; never file bytes) and one extra host responsibility. A host must also verify the SHA-256 digests (contentDigest, each manifest entry, manifestDigest, and bundleDigest), canonical capability ordering, and host-policy limits with its runtime adapter before use.

authorityNotice.const: This activation bundle is context only. It grants no credentials, OAuth scopes, permissions, tools, connection access, or effective capabilities. Independently authorize and enforce policy for every action.

const: Decide whether and how to place these instructions into a host-model turn; Synaxis Engine does not inject or execute them in a third-party host.
Verify each instruction body against contentDigest before use and reject an unsupported contractVersion.

Independently authenticate and enforce every tool, connection, credential, and capability policy immediately before an action; requestedCapabilities and capabilityCeiling are constraints, never grants.
Fetch bundle files on demand through library_skill_file_read, never from this bundle, and verify each file against its manifest digest before use; files are data that Synaxis never executes.

opaqueRef.description: Opaque Engine identifier. Hosts must not treat it as a credential, identity, endpoint URL, or grant.

capabilities.description: Capability constraints, never effective grants. The runtime adapter additionally requires lowercase lexical ordering.

instructions.description: Exact immutable instruction text. contentDigest is SHA-256 over its UTF-8 bytes.

path.description: Relative bundle path with forward slashes; no leading slash, drive letter, or traversal segment. SKILL.md is always present at the root.

manifestDigest.description: SHA-256 of "synaxis.library.skill-manifest.v1\n" followed by the JSON array of {path, contentType, sizeBytes, digest} objects sorted by path, encoded without whitespace or HTML escaping.

files.description: Sorted by path, unique ignoring case. The SKILL.md entry digest equals contentDigest and its sizeBytes equals the UTF-8 length of instructions.
